hint.name: seedit
hint.text: Inside Orivon, seedit runs as its desktop app, with a Bitsocial node of its own on your computer to host and read communities.
hint.notice: Early access. In this build a community you create may not be reachable from other computers while you are behind a router.

build.command: NODE_ENV=production PUBLIC_URL=./ GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false npx vite build
